findings.summary: P2: completed-repair-scope-request.ts uses git log --full-history -m without fixing the merge diff mode. With log.diffMerges=off, the independently retained genuine merge fixture omits merge-resolution-only source.ts. gitProofEnv disables replacement objects but does not isolate log.diffMerges. The history predicate can therefore miss source changes after the consumed blocker. Use explicit --diff-merges=separate in the same approved helper and add configuration-negative coverage in the existing scope command test. Native full008 passed on178357, but the uncovered configuration case prevents semantic acceptance.
